subject: WeaveHealth: Special retention package & SLA add-on request
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@weavehealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: WeaveHealth: Special retention package & SLA add-on request

Team —

Quick context: WeaveHealth (annual contract, $720k ARR) signaled last week they may not renew because of a few sustained latency incidents and cost pressures tied to spike usage. Procurement asked if we can put together a short-term bridge package (6–9 months) with a temporary term reset, a modest one-time credit, and an SLA add-on to buy time while they migrate some workloads.

I attached a proposed package (weave-bridge-proposal.pdf) and a term sheet. Key ask to Deal Desk / Exec: permission to offer up to 18% one-time credit, a 9-month term reset at current price, plus a limited SLA add-on (99.9% with a $20k credit pool for incidents) — all contingent on a joint technical review and telemetry sharing.

TL;DR ask (single-line for exec): approval to offer the attached bridge package (DL-4979) including 18% credit cap + 9-month term reset + SLA add-on. Need an approval path for exceptions to standard discount caps and SLA language.

Why this is time-sensitive: procurement wants a written proposal by end of day Monday (6/28) to keep negotiations moving; their renewal window closes 7/6.

Attachments: weave-bridge-proposal.pdf, sla-addon-term-sheet.xlsx, weave-usage-telemetry.csv

Marked for: Ben (pricing ops) — can you sanity-check economics?
Marked for: Laura — legal review of SLA addendum language?
Marked for: Naomi — P&L impact and credit accounting guidance?

Thanks —
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@weavehealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: WeaveHealth: Special retention package & SLA add-on request

Marcus —

Thanks for the clear ask and the modeling in the deck. Initial thoughts:
- 18% one-time credit is within stretch (but hits margin). If we tie the credit to staged milestones (1/2 up front, 1/2 after 90 days with telemetry review), it improves our downside.
- 9-month term reset at current price is acceptable if we require a minimum usage floor (70% of current baseline) to avoid pure churn.
- SLA add-on $20k incident pool is reasonable as a temporary concession.

I ran a quick back-of-envelope: worst-case P&L hit ~ $128k in year one (credit + potential overage protection). That looks manageable given the retention probability improvement.

Action items for me: I’ll prepare a pricing note with bullets and the maximum approval gates needed, plus a costing line for Finance.

Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Pricing & Commercial Ops
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@weavehealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-25T12:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: WeaveHealth: Special retention package & SLA add-on request

Marcus / team —

Quick legal read: the SLA addendum language attached needs two edits before I can sign off:
1) Limit the incident credit pool to covered event types only (exclude third-party infra)
2) Add a 90-day cure period and a mutual termination right if telemetry shows repeated misuse.

Separately, if we’re putting this on a short-term reset, we should include an explicit rollback clause that returns the account to standard terms at the reset end date unless a renewal is executed. That protects us operationally.

If Ben agrees to milestone-based credit, Legal can work to tighten the conditional language and provide a redline by EOD.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@weavehealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-25T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: WeaveHealth: Special retention package & SLA add-on request

Attached an abbreviated P&L impact (see weave-usage-telemetry.csv) and a credit accounting note. Highlights:
- One-time credit cap of 18% equates to ~$129,600 on current ARR; recognize as contra-revenue across the bridge term.
- If we do milestone payments, we should escrow the second tranche until the 90-day telemetry check completes.
- Recommend structuring the SLA credit as a capped liability line for the fiscal quarter to avoid surprise impact.

I can present the finance note to the deal committee if we want a final sign-off today.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Revenue Finance
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Emily Park <emily.park@weavehealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-25T17:43:00-07:00
Subject: REQUEST: Executive approval for DL-4979 bridge package (decision needed)

Aditya —

WeaveHealth is asking for a time-limited bridge to avoid churn. Deal highlights in one line: 9-month term reset, one-time credit up to 18% (~$129.6k), and a capped $20k SLA incident pool. We require flexibility on discount cap & SLA language to finalize the proposal by Monday.

Requested action: please approve the package as-is, or reply with the maximum one-time credit you’ll authorize (if <18%) and whether we have authority to offer the SLA add-on. If you prefer, I can convert the pricing to a staged credit option per Ben’s note.

Why I’m asking you: this is outside standard discount approval gates and will require an exec sign-off for our Q3 retention docket. Losing the account would represent material ARR leakage and create a larger churn lift later.

I’ve attached the final drafts and finance notes. If you’re available, happy to jump on a 15-minute call now.

Thanks —
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: weave-bridge-proposal.pdf, sla-addon-term-sheet.xlsx, weave-usage-telemetry.csv
